race.comment: FROSTRATION (8) is in top form this campaign having won his past two, too strong again last time at Donald having won over this route prior in a BM52. Finds another very suitable affair and can keep the ball rolling. BRASSI ROAD (13) missed out last time when fourth over 1590m at Wangaratta after filling a minor placing in two races on end, the latest here over 1590m. He struggles to win but draws well and should be right there. UNDER THE HAT (4) wasn't far away at Pakenham Synthetic last start when fourth over this trip. She won't need to improve much at all to be figuring here. FOGGY BOTTOM (10) finished 11th two runs back then improved last start but found one better over 1590m at Wangaratta, beaten 6 lengths. Each way hope again. ZIGGY STARCRAFT (5) is going okay and has place claims.
